about.title: About us
about.lead: Momtaz Shahd bakes traditional Iranian koloocheh and kolompeh with authentic recipes and fresh ingredients.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: Koloocheh and kolompeh are part of the memory of Iranian homes: the smell of cinnamon and cardamom, a warm cookie beside a glass of tea. Momtaz Shahd was founded to keep that taste alive, exactly as it should be.
story.p2: We still work the traditional way — good flour, fresh walnuts, select dates and real spices — while baking in a clean, modern facility and packing each product so that it reaches you fresh.

ingredients.title: Honest ingredients
ingredients.text: We choose every ingredient ourselves and list what goes into each product.

wholesalePage.title: Wholesale
wholesalePage.lead: Koloocheh and kolompeh for shops, cafés, hotels and distributors — at factory prices.

hero.title: Fresh from our bakery to your shelves
hero.text: Momtaz Shahd supplies shops, cafés, hotels, offices and distributors across Iran. Order by the carton at wholesale prices, pay by bank transfer with an official invoice, and get regular deliveries straight from the bakery.

minimum.label: Minimum order
minimum.value: From 5,000,000 Toman per order — products can be mixed

payment.label: Payment
payment.value: Bank transfer or online payment, with an official invoice

delivery.label: Delivery
delivery.value: Nationwide by freight or Tipax, usually within 2–5 working days

prices.title: Factory prices
prices.text: Lower unit prices from the minimum quantity, with no middleman.

fresh.title: Baked to order
fresh.text: Large orders are baked fresh and packed for a long shelf life.

shipping.title: Reliable shipping
shipping.text: Careful packing in cartons and tracked delivery to every province.

invoice.title: Official invoice
invoice.text: Every wholesale order comes with a proper invoice for your books.

support.title: A dedicated contact
support.text: One person on our sales team follows your orders from start to finish.

display.title: Shop display support
display.text: Shelf displays and promotional material for regular partners.

tiers.title: Wholesale price list
tiers.text: Wholesale prices apply automatically in the cart when you order at least the minimum quantity of a product. Signed-in wholesale customers also get the quick bulk order form.
tiers.empty: The wholesale price list will be published soon.
tiers.note: Prices include packaging and exclude shipping. Larger or recurring orders: ask us for a quote.

who.a: Shops, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, hotels, offices and distributors. Individuals buying for events are welcome too.

minimum.a: Each product has a minimum quantity for its wholesale price, shown in the table above. Mixed orders from about 5 million Toman are easiest for us to ship.

prices.q: How do I get the wholesale price?
prices.a: Add at least the minimum quantity of a product to your cart and the wholesale price applies automatically. After we approve your request, your account also gets the bulk order form.

payment.a: Online payment or bank transfer. For bank transfers you upload the receipt on your order page and we confirm it within a working day.

delivery.a: Usually 2–5 working days depending on the city. Very large orders are baked to order and may need a few extra days.

samples.q: Can I try the products first?
samples.a: Yes. Mention it in your request and we will arrange a sample box for businesses.

dealer.q: How do I become an official dealer?
dealer.a: Fill in the dealership application. We look at your location and sales channel and get back to you.
